matieres-macro.jpg: Photorealistic luxury jewelry editorial macro still life, landscape 1536x1024. A small cluster of 5 loose colourless brilliant cut gemstones of varied sizes resting on a dark charcoal jeweler's velvet tray, next to three simple curved samples of polished pale yellow gold, rose gold and white silver metal. Extremely close macro camera, large facets and tactile metal surfaces fill the right two thirds of the frame. Left third almost black negative space with subtle velvet texture. Strong controlled narrow stripbox reflections, white gemstones clearly visible yet realistic, warm muted champagne rim light and deep black shadows. Elegant quiet fine jewelry magazine photography, 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field but central stone tack sharp. No text, no logo, no labels, no starburst graphics, no hands. This is an illustrative material study not actual inventory.
esquisse.jpg: Photorealistic editorial jewelry design still life, landscape 1536x1024. Close overhead oblique view of an ivory textured drawing paper on a dark walnut jeweler's table. On the paper is a beautifully executed graphite design sketch of a chunky connected 93 pendant, a squared nine and squared three, one small bail above, drawn with fine pencil construction lines and little detailed dot indications for pave stones. A mechanical pencil lies diagonally beside it, one small loupe and three tiny clear loose stones near top edge. No hands or person. Paper occupies 80 percent image, image cropped closely. Restrained daylight from left creates gentle elongated shadows. Luxury commissioned jewelry design mood, documentary magazine photography, authentic paper fibers, fine drafting pencil marks, monochrome cream charcoal and warm walnut. No written labels, no additional text, no logo, no fake certificates. Illustration of an initial design idea, not proof of a real workshop.
